from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a value as indented JSON
prompt > runPrompt() > writes `undefined` for a value nothing else can be written for

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns `undefined` for a value nothing else can be written for

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a value's acted-on characters as the escapes JSON spells them with

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns a value's acted-on characters as the escapes JSON spells them with

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a value holding no acted-on character unchanged

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns a value holding no acted-on character unchanged

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > leaves the line breaks the writer laid the value out with

to.n: value > renderValue() > leaves the line breaks the writer laid the value out with

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a line break inside a value as the escape, not as a break

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns a line break inside a value as the escape, not as a break

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a value that still parses back to the value it was

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns a rendering that still parses back to the value it was

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > names the kind of a value JSON has no form for, rather than the word

to.n: value > renderValue() > names the kind of a value JSON has no form for, rather than the word

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > drops a nested value JSON has no form for, and says nothing

to.n: value > renderValue() > drops a nested value JSON has no form for, and says nothing

from.n: prompt > runPrompt() > writes a `bigint` the way `cf cell get` writes one

to.n: value > renderValue() > returns a `bigint` the way `cf cell get` writes one
